title: The ramp
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies (the trilogy ran in print in three papers)
logline: Tuesday. Gully builds a ramp at the dock's steps. Two planks, a strip of roofing felt for grip. He doesn't say who it's for. The dog uses it once, to show he can, then lets himself be carried anyway.

panels.composition: The shack steps. GULLY screwing two planks into a ramp beside them, roofing felt on top. WOOD arriving with BARNABY in his arms.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a stocky man screwing two planks into a ramp beside shack steps with roofing felt on top while a thin man arrives carrying an old dog

balloons.text: For the — it's a ramp, Woody. Put him on it.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a stocky man speaking to a thin man without looking up from a ramp he is building

panels.composition: The dog set at the ramp's foot. Walking up it. Slowly. All the way. Turning at the top to look at them both.

characters.pose: at the top of the ramp, looking back

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, an old dog reaching the top of a short plank ramp and turning to look back at two men, no words

panels.composition: The dog lying down at the top, done. Wood picking him up anyway. Gully with the drill, looking at the ramp he'll keep for ten years.

image.prompt: quiet ink line with water bleeding over the edges, desaturated wet-on-wet in raw umber and Payne's gray and Prussian blue, a thin man lifting an old dog from the top of a plank ramp while a stocky man with a drill looks at the ramp, no words
image.notes: The ramp stays on the dock through 2027 (objects.md, Gully's dock).
